scope: Actual isolated PostgreSQL plus explicitly simulated Discord REST/Gateway/interactions; zero external posts, provider wallets or human verification

checks.name: Game Coin marketplace uses explicit listing and purchase previews with separate verified-user confirmation interactions
self-purchase refusal explains ownership and original-listing withdrawal without suggesting broken identity setup
blockchain asset registration previews and explicit confirmations retain the actual Discord actor and original opaque operation ID
expired initial acknowledgements execute no inventory/payment/agent operation and diagnostics retain numeric Discord codes without private provider payloads
third Discord owner receives a scoped CityAgent3 grant without taking either occupied slot
default on-chain coordinator refuses stale coin buttons before effects and forwards resource count and CITY browse without coin controls
organized mode links the persistent private agent room and routes notifications without general-channel panels
